# Amateur variant without cognates (es and hi)

`es-amateur-lexodle-nocognate` is the Lexodle amateur with cognate use removed. It drops
P6 (cognate letter overlap) and the cross-language similarity vote P3 on English options,
which is also cognate guessing in practice. What remains: elimination (P7) and random ties.
Measured: unknown written items at chance (about 26 percent), so the excess of the cognate
variant is cognate guessing, not the bank.
